# Legal Marketing Firm (LegalMarketingFirm.net)

> A legal marketing firm for law firms: SEO, paid search, AI search optimization (GEO/AEO) and integrated advertising, measured by qualified intake and signed cases. Contact: hello@legalmarketingfirm.net. We are a marketing agency, not a law firm.

## Core
- [Services](https://www.legalmarketingfirm.net/services/): all law firm marketing services
- [Practice areas](https://www.legalmarketingfirm.net/practice-areas/): marketing by practice
- [Markets](https://www.legalmarketingfirm.net/markets/): 163 U.S. markets
- [Results](https://www.legalmarketingfirm.net/results/): case study scoreboard
- [Free marketing audit](https://www.legalmarketingfirm.net/free-marketing-audit/): TriSearch Growth Audit (0–100 across SEO, paid search, GEO)
